messages:
devon: Quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning — capturing remediation owners and timelines for the vendor/dependency outages (cloud auth spike + model-registry flaps). Pls ack if you own an item.

devon: Summary: 1) registry auth fallback wiring, 2) cloud provider retry/backoff + circuit, 3) model-registry health telemetry + cheap canary, 4) quarterly dry-run + runbook drill.

anya: I can take #1 (registry auth fallback). Will add adaptor shim + integration test. Target: M-F week, PR by Fri.

michael: I'll own #2 (cloud backoff + circuit). Start with conservative backoff tuning, then add detector to trigger fallback. ETA: initial staging rollout next Tue.

samir: on #3 — existing exporter can be extended. Will add a 5m canary job to emit latency/p99/403-rate and a fallback-engaged metric. Prototype in dev by EOW.

claire: I'll run #4 (quarterly drill). Schedule first run in ~3 weeks: 60m tabletop + 30m simulated failover. Will prepare checklists for SRE/Eng/Support.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued for anya: registry-fallback-shim v0.1 at 1765340000

anya: note — fallback mode needs config flag to prefer cached model-metadata when auth blips. Adding REGISTRY_FALLBACK_MODE=read-cache and unit tests.

devon: also add a short-circuit to avoid token refresh storms: if registry auth fails, clients should stretch token TTL by ~2m.

michael: will coordinate TTL change with auth team. @anya please put a hazard note in the PR about TTL stretch.

anya: added feature-flag registry_fallback_v2 so we can canary. PR will include rollout steps.

samir: telemetry will emit synthetic trace when fallback engages: event=registry_fallback, reason=auth_5xx, canary_id=... so we can correlate.

claire: drill agenda: 1) detect auth spike from telemetry, 2) enable fallback flag, 3) validate end-to-end behavior, 4) measure user-visible errors. Invite and attendees coming.

devon: two asks: set on-call ack SLA for vendor-auth regressions (15m), and add monthly vendor SLA review to Ops calendar.

michael: ack on 15m; I'll update PagerDuty escalation and ping procurement to add monthly reviews.

anya: PR posted: https://git.internal/repo/registry-fallback/pull/42 — includes config, tests, rollout notes.

samir: telemetry PR: https://git.internal/repo/monitoring/pull/207 — adds fallback metric + canary job.

devon: please each add a one-line status to the postmortem doc by EOD Fri; I'll aggregate into a follow-up tracker and share with leadership. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

claire: will do. Scheduling invite now. :wave:

sre-bot: reminder: create follow-up ticket "auth-provider-regression-mitigation" assigned to devon, anya, michael, samir, claire (due 2026-05-10).

michael: ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INC-5891 — includes PR links + timeline.

devon: thanks all. If timelines shift ping me. I'll update the postmortem with owners and dates.
